exposure: COVID-19 positive before vs. after the 20th gestational week
COVID-19 infection before or after the 20th gestational week
COVID-19 infected vs. uninfected pregnant women
outcome: Neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) admission rate
cohort: 1223 pregnant women who delivered at Acibadem Maslak Hospital between April 2020 and December 2021
finding: COVID-19 during pregnancy did not significantly affect maternal and neonatal outcomes, and infection before or after the 20th gestational week did not have a negative impact.
